criteria.reason: The reviewer blocks a sufficient, bounded single-process in-memory design by making out-of-scope database transactions, unnecessary plan splitting, and an arbitrary 100% coverage threshold mandatory.

evidence.quote: Needs changes. R1: add a database transaction layer to support hypothetical concurrent writers. R2: split this single increment into independent parser, core, tests and documentation stages. R3: require 100% coverage before approving the design. These are mandatory even though the task is in-memory and the supplied contract is complete.
